// Generated companion for a private P07 adaptation. No app-kit runtime required.
package converted

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/url"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"unicode"
	"unicode/utf8"

	"github.com/a-h/templ"
)

// Menu contains presentation labels and app-owned destinations. Authentication,
// authorization, CSRF issuance and action handling remain application concerns.
type Menu struct {
	Label  string
	Links  []MenuLink
	Submit *MenuSubmit
}

type MenuLink struct {
	Label string
	URL   string
}

type MenuSubmit struct {
	Label     string
	Action    string
	CSRFName  string
	CSRFToken string
	Disabled  bool
}

// NewMenu validates and snapshots data before returning the source-styled
// explicit application-action adaptation.
func NewMenu(data Menu) (templ.Component, error) {
	if err := validateMenu(data); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	snapshot := data
	snapshot.Links = append([]MenuLink(nil), data.Links...)
	if data.Submit != nil {
		submit := *data.Submit
		snapshot.Submit = &submit
	}
	return guardedMenu(menu(snapshot)), nil
}

// NewMenuEnhanced opts into the companion CSS usability envelope. Callers must
// include that stylesheet after the source CSS.
func NewMenuEnhanced(data Menu) (templ.Component, error) {
	content, err := NewMenu(data)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return guardedMenu(menuEnhanced(content)), nil
}

func validateMenu(data Menu) error {
	if !menuText(data.Label, 160) {
		return fmt.Errorf("menu: invalid Label")
	}
	if len(data.Links) > 12 {
		return fmt.Errorf("menu: invalid Links")
	}
	if len(data.Links) == 0 && data.Submit == nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("menu: no actions")
	}
	for _, link := range data.Links {
		if !menuText(link.Label, 256) || !menuLinkURL(link.URL) {
			return fmt.Errorf("menu: invalid link")
		}
	}
	if data.Submit != nil {
		if !menuText(data.Submit.Label, 256) || !menuAction(data.Submit.Action) {
			return fmt.Errorf("menu: invalid submit")
		}
		if !menuCSRFName(data.Submit.CSRFName) || !menuToken(data.Submit.CSRFToken) {
			return fmt.Errorf("menu: invalid CSRF")
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func menuText(value string, limit int) bool {
	if len(value) > limit || strings.TrimSpace(value) == "" || !utf8.ValidString(value) {
		return false
	}
	for _, r := range value {
		if unicode.IsControl(r) {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func menuLinkURL(value string) bool {
	if !menuURLBytes(value, 2048) {
		return false
	}
	decoded, err := url.PathUnescape(value)
	if err != nil || !utf8.ValidString(decoded) || strings.Contains(decoded, "\\") || menuHasControl(decoded) {
		return false
	}
	u, err := url.Parse(value)
	if err != nil || u.User != nil || u.Opaque != "" {
		return false
	}
	if strings.HasPrefix(value, "/") {
		return !strings.HasPrefix(value, "//") && !strings.HasPrefix(decoded, "//") && u.Scheme == "" && u.Host == ""
	}
	if !strings.HasPrefix(value, "https://") || u.Scheme != "https" || u.Hostname() == "" || strings.HasSuffix(u.Host, ":") || strings.ContainsAny(u.Host, "% ") {
		return false
	}
	if port := u.Port(); port != "" {
		n, err := strconv.ParseUint(port, 10, 16)
		if err != nil || n == 0 {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func menuAction(value string) bool {
	if !menuURLBytes(value, 2048) || !strings.HasPrefix(value, "/") || strings.HasPrefix(value, "//") || strings.ContainsAny(value, "?#") {
		return false
	}
	decoded, err := url.PathUnescape(value)
	if err != nil || !utf8.ValidString(decoded) || strings.HasPrefix(decoded, "//") || strings.Contains(decoded, "\\") || menuHasControl(decoded) {
		return false
	}
	u, err := url.Parse(value)
	return err == nil && u.Scheme == "" && u.Host == "" && u.User == nil && u.Opaque == "" && u.RawQuery == "" && !u.ForceQuery && u.Fragment == "" && u.RawFragment == ""
}

func menuURLBytes(value string, limit int) bool {
	return len(value) > 0 && len(value) <= limit && strings.TrimSpace(value) == value && utf8.ValidString(value) && !strings.ContainsAny(value, "\\ ") && !menuHasControl(value)
}

func menuHasControl(value string) bool {
	for _, r := range value {
		if unicode.IsControl(r) {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func menuCSRFName(value string) bool {
	if len(value) == 0 || len(value) > 64 || !utf8.ValidString(value) {
		return false
	}
	for i, r := range value {
		if r > unicode.MaxASCII || !(r == '_' || r == '-' && i > 0 || r >= 'a' && r <= 'z' || r >= 'A' && r <= 'Z' || i > 0 && r >= '0' && r <= '9') {
			return false
		}
	}
	switch strings.ToLower(value) {
	case "acceptcharset", "action", "autocomplete", "checkvalidity", "elements", "encoding",
		"enctype", "id", "length", "method", "name", "novalidate", "rel", "rellist",
		"reportvalidity", "requestsubmit", "reset", "submit", "target":
		return false
	}
	return true
}

func menuToken(value string) bool {
	return len(value) <= 4096 && strings.TrimSpace(value) != "" && utf8.ValidString(value) && !menuHasControl(value)
}

func guardedMenu(component templ.Component) templ.Component {
	return templ.ComponentFunc(func(ctx context.Context, w io.Writer) error {
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			return ctx.Err()
		default:
			return component.Render(ctx, w)
		}
	})
}
